column1: # Proof-escape waiver ledger for the Idris2 ABI model.
# Every escape construct in this package is a hole in the proof: `postulate`
# asserts without proving, `believe_me` casts between unrelated types,
# the guarantee a definition carries. The gate (scripts/idris_escape_scan.sh)
# rejects all of them. This file is the only way to keep one, and a row here
# is a reviewed, permanent, public admission that a proof is missing.
#   1. mark the line in the .idr source:  -- ESCAPE-WAIVER: <id>
# <file> is relative to this directory. <id> is matched, not the line number,
# so inserting a line above an escape cannot silently transfer its waiver to
# different code. One id excuses exactly one line; the gate fails if a row
# matches no escape (a stale permission the next escape would inherit), if it
# names the wrong term or file, or if the same id is claimed twice.
